verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is designed for local/on-device inference (CPU+GPU hybrid, quantization, Metal/CUDA support) and all evidence describes running models locally, including techniques to fit oversized models on local hardware; there is no mention of any hosted cloud tier or ability to offload model execution to a remote service without downloading it. missing for 10: any documentation of a cloud-hosted inference tier, remote model execution API, or 'run without local download' feature.
